evidenceClasses.analysis-scope: A boundary preventing selected evidence or undefined Historical Load from being overread.
evidenceClasses.exact-projection-comparison: Exact equality under one declared witness-identity regime.
evidenceClasses.published-correction-profile: The published 207-reading profile supporting correction from a second exemplar.
evidenceClasses.published-transmission-analysis: A copying or correction-source relation attributed to the published analysis, never direct observation.
evidenceClasses.scholarly-claim: A page-located statement in Robinson's published analysis.
evidenceClasses.selected-collation-reading: A bounded projection of an exact NEXUS reading; it creates no ancestry.
evidenceClasses.selected-site-equality: Exact equality over two deliberately selected examples; non-representative and non-ancestral.

identityRegimes.scholarly-group: Does the published analysis place the witnesses in the same group?

identityRegimes.witness-record: Do the records name the same exact witness?

boundary.note: Shared readings create neither ancestry nor copying. The better copy remains unresolved. Historical Load is undefined because no route space, admissibility rule, cost functional, or baseline route is supplied.
boundary.summary: Recorded readings, derived agreement, attributed copying, and attributed contamination remain separate layers.
boundary.title: Reading / transmission boundary
